meta.title: Extrasolar Planet
meta.description: The solidified alien star and melted tears join together to form a sticky obsession, never to be separated again.

units.rawText: Professor?
units.displayText: Professor?

spans.text: Professor?

units.rawText: Hehehe... I see you remain silent, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehehe... I see you remain silent, Professor.

spans.text: Hehehe... I see you remain silent, Professor.

units.rawText: When I become a threat to the Oasis, you would stand against me as well.
units.displayText: When I become a threat to the Oasis, you would stand against me as well.

spans.text: When I become a threat to the Oasis, you would stand against me as well.

units.rawText: What guides you is little more than fragile emotions, not any enduring power.
units.displayText: What guides you is little more than fragile emotions, not any enduring power.

spans.text: What guides you is little more than fragile emotions, not any enduring power.

units.rawText: You cannot preserve any star with such an unsteady will.
units.displayText: You cannot preserve any star with such an unsteady will.

spans.text: You cannot preserve any star with such an unsteady will.

options.rawText: I'll find some way to hold onto you.
options.displayText: I'll find some way to hold onto you.

spans.text: I'll find some way to hold onto you.

options.rawText: Emotions in and of themselves are enduring power.
options.displayText: Emotions in and of themselves are enduring power.

spans.text: Emotions in and of themselves are enduring power.

units.rawText: We'll hold onto you tight, and we already have some notions. Haven't you recovered a good amount of your memories already?
units.displayText: We'll hold onto you tight, and we already have some notions. Haven't you recovered a good amount of your memories already?

spans.text: We'll hold onto you tight, and we already have some notions. Haven't you recovered a good amount of your memories already?

units.rawText: You may not be able to control yourself very well currently, but it's alright. It'll get better. Our Hubble remembers the position of every star, and knows each and every orbit.
units.displayText: You may not be able to control yourself very well currently, but it's alright. It'll get better. Our Hubble remembers the position of every star, and knows each and every orbit.

spans.text: You may not be able to control yourself very well currently, but it's alright. It'll get better. Our Hubble remembers the position of every star, and knows each and every orbit.

units.rawText: Hehe... it appears I must keep myself answerable to your expectations. How sly of you, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehe... it appears I must keep myself answerable to your expectations. How sly of you, Professor.

spans.text: Hehe... it appears I must keep myself answerable to your expectations. How sly of you, Professor.

units.rawText: If we had only just reconvened, you would not question us like this.
units.displayText: If we had only just reconvened, you would not question us like this.

spans.text: If we had only just reconvened, you would not question us like this.

units.rawText: For you to have concerns and suspicions already proves that the connections between us are rekindling. If you had never considered the reunion in the first place, you would not even begin to contemplate the difference in standings, right?
units.displayText: For you to have concerns and suspicions already proves that the connections between us are rekindling. If you had never considered the reunion in the first place, you would not even begin to contemplate the difference in standings, right?

spans.text: For you to have concerns and suspicions already proves that the connections between us are rekindling. If you had never considered the reunion in the first place, you would not even begin to contemplate the difference in standings, right?

units.rawText: Well well... what an angle of approach. Your methods truly are exceptional.
units.displayText: Well well... what an angle of approach. Your methods truly are exceptional.

spans.text: Well well... what an angle of approach. Your methods truly are exceptional.

units.rawText: Though we cannot offer any promises of substance...
units.displayText: Though we cannot offer any promises of substance...

spans.text: Though we cannot offer any promises of substance...

units.rawText: A stargazer always turns their sights to the stars.
units.displayText: A stargazer always turns their sights to the stars.

spans.text: A stargazer always turns their sights to the stars.

units.rawText: What riveting prose. I cannot wait to see the results for myself.
units.displayText: What riveting prose. I cannot wait to see the results for myself.

spans.text: What riveting prose. I cannot wait to see the results for myself.

units.rawText: But Entropics and Agents... two different systems altogether. Your attitude towards them, Xuannu's actions—they all serve to prove that point.
units.displayText: But Entropics and Agents... two different systems altogether. Your attitude towards them, Xuannu's actions—they all serve to prove that point.

spans.text: But Entropics and Agents... two different systems altogether. Your attitude towards them, Xuannu's actions—they all serve to prove that point.

units.rawText: How will you manage it, I wonder? A most captivating thing.
units.displayText: How will you manage it, I wonder? A most captivating thing.

spans.text: How will you manage it, I wonder? A most captivating thing.

units.rawText: I can already feel it, the integration of bodies... one last piece of the puzzle is missing. Shall we move towards the final moment, then?
units.displayText: I can already feel it, the integration of bodies... one last piece of the puzzle is missing. Shall we move towards the final moment, then?

spans.text: I can already feel it, the integration of bodies... one last piece of the puzzle is missing. Shall we move towards the final moment, then?

units.rawText: Looks like you are not so easily convinced, then. That is as well. Let's see what happens at the end.
units.displayText: Looks like you are not so easily convinced, then. That is as well. Let's see what happens at the end.

spans.text: Looks like you are not so easily convinced, then. That is as well. Let's see what happens at the end.

units.rawText: Antonina, do we have any leads on our final piece of memory data?
units.displayText: Antonina, do we have any leads on our final piece of memory data?

spans.text: Antonina, do we have any leads on our final piece of memory data?

units.rawText: Yeah, since ages ago, we were just waiting for this positively inconversant Professor to finish their conversation with Hubble!
units.displayText: Yeah, since ages ago, we were just waiting for this positively inconversant Professor to finish their conversation with Hubble!

spans.text: Yeah, since ages ago, we were just waiting for this positively inconversant Professor to finish their conversation with Hubble!

units.rawText: Pfft...
units.displayText: Pfft...

spans.text: Pfft...

units.rawText: What a pain. Go, get on with the work! Once we have this final part, we can put together Hubble's main body of data.
units.displayText: What a pain. Go, get on with the work! Once we have this final part, we can put together Hubble's main body of data.

spans.text: What a pain. Go, get on with the work! Once we have this final part, we can put together Hubble's main body of data.

units.rawText: With a complete Hubble, we can maybe figure out with the data what happened in those last moments.
units.displayText: With a complete Hubble, we can maybe figure out with the data what happened in those last moments.

spans.text: With a complete Hubble, we can maybe figure out with the data what happened in those last moments.

units.rawText: Hopefully then some of the mysteries can be revealed.
units.displayText: Hopefully then some of the mysteries can be revealed.

spans.text: Hopefully then some of the mysteries can be revealed.

units.rawText: Yes, it will soon be at an end. Along with all of this ambivalence...
units.displayText: Yes, it will soon be at an end. Along with all of this ambivalence...

spans.text: Yes, it will soon be at an end. Along with all of this ambivalence...

units.rawText: No matter what your decision is at the end of it all... at least, this journey of memory-seeking, we will finish together.
units.displayText: No matter what your decision is at the end of it all... at least, this journey of memory-seeking, we will finish together.

spans.text: No matter what your decision is at the end of it all... at least, this journey of memory-seeking, we will finish together.

units.rawText: Hehe, naturally.
units.displayText: Hehe, naturally.

spans.text: Hehe, naturally.

units.rawText: On this road, crossing paths with the alien star shall also bring forth the end.
units.displayText: On this road, crossing paths with the alien star shall also bring forth the end.

spans.text: On this road, crossing paths with the alien star shall also bring forth the end.

units.rawText: The spaceship steadily journeys on towards its destination, passing planets both intimate and foreign, belts rich with minerals...
units.displayText: The spaceship steadily journeys on towards its destination, passing planets both intimate and foreign, belts rich with minerals...

spans.text: The spaceship steadily journeys on towards its destination, passing planets both intimate and foreign, belts rich with minerals...

units.rawText: Here resides no new planet to explore, or grand center of the Starsphere. In this empty place a damaged escape pod is lodged, housed upon a great drifting asteroid.
units.displayText: Here resides no new planet to explore, or grand center of the Starsphere. In this empty place a damaged escape pod is lodged, housed upon a great drifting asteroid.

spans.text: Here resides no new planet to explore, or grand center of the Starsphere. In this empty place a damaged escape pod is lodged, housed upon a great drifting asteroid.

units.rawText: This is... back then...
units.displayText: This is... back then...

spans.text: This is... back then...

units.rawText: A place of parting?
units.displayText: A place of parting?

spans.text: A place of parting?

units.rawText: Hubble, you remember!?
units.displayText: Hubble, you remember!?

spans.text: Hubble, you remember!?

units.rawText: No, I just... suddenly had such a thought.
units.displayText: No, I just... suddenly had such a thought.

spans.text: No, I just... suddenly had such a thought.

units.rawText: ...Yeah. Here is... where we last parted.
units.displayText: ...Yeah. Here is... where we last parted.

spans.text: ...Yeah. Here is... where we last parted.

units.rawText: Hubble, you were more compassionate than I could ever have imagined, but also cruel beyond what was possible. But... no one here can blame you.
units.displayText: Hubble, you were more compassionate than I could ever have imagined, but also cruel beyond what was possible. But... no one here can blame you.

spans.text: Hubble, you were more compassionate than I could ever have imagined, but also cruel beyond what was possible. But... no one here can blame you.

units.rawText: After that, it was... a terribly, terribly long wait until I could gather up the courage to come to this Starsphere.
units.displayText: After that, it was... a terribly, terribly long wait until I could gather up the courage to come to this Starsphere.

spans.text: After that, it was... a terribly, terribly long wait until I could gather up the courage to come to this Starsphere.

units.rawText: I thought that we would find your... fragments...
units.displayText: I thought that we would find your... fragments...

spans.text: I thought that we would find your... fragments...

units.rawText: But thankfully we found you.
units.displayText: But thankfully we found you.

spans.text: But thankfully we found you.

units.rawText: It is a shame... I cannot recall how I felt in that moment.
units.displayText: It is a shame... I cannot recall how I felt in that moment.

spans.text: It is a shame... I cannot recall how I felt in that moment.

units.rawText: Perhaps it resides someplace inside my neural cloud, waiting to be awakened...
units.displayText: Perhaps it resides someplace inside my neural cloud, waiting to be awakened...

spans.text: Perhaps it resides someplace inside my neural cloud, waiting to be awakened...

units.rawText: Then, let us see what rests here in this "place of parting".
units.displayText: Then, let us see what rests here in this "place of parting".

spans.text: Then, let us see what rests here in this "place of parting".

units.rawText: The reunited friends exit the cabin together. Fresnel was attached to a tether this time. Within the shattered escape pod, a piece of memory data gives off a warm and fuzzy light.
units.displayText: The reunited friends exit the cabin together. Fresnel was attached to a tether this time. Within the shattered escape pod, a piece of memory data gives off a warm and fuzzy light.

spans.text: The reunited friends exit the cabin together. Fresnel was attached to a tether this time. Within the shattered escape pod, a piece of memory data gives off a warm and fuzzy light.

units.rawText: These are... memories of the real world?
units.displayText: These are... memories of the real world?

spans.text: These are... memories of the real world?

units.rawText: What do you think of the structure of this story?
units.displayText: What do you think of the structure of this story?

spans.text: What do you think of the structure of this story?

units.rawText: Mm, hmm... it is indeed interesting to characterize a celestial body's life cycle as that of a person's.
units.displayText: Mm, hmm... it is indeed interesting to characterize a celestial body's life cycle as that of a person's.

spans.text: Mm, hmm... it is indeed interesting to characterize a celestial body's life cycle as that of a person's.

units.rawText: Though, isn't some of this prose... a little bit too bleak?
units.displayText: Though, isn't some of this prose... a little bit too bleak?

spans.text: Though, isn't some of this prose... a little bit too bleak?

units.rawText: Is that so? I remember this segment was my own personal conceptual work...
units.displayText: Is that so? I remember this segment was my own personal conceptual work...

spans.text: Is that so? I remember this segment was my own personal conceptual work...

spans.text: "Finally, it decided it would be a new solar system."
"The star would shine, the planets would revolve, and all shall be in its rightful place."
"Nothing needs to be annihilated. Every life shall have the right to continue."
"And the only price is that it would forget everything..."

units.rawText:
"Forgetting what made it thirst such to make a star shine to, forgetting how it would be enamored with the empyrean's orbits."<|>
"Forgetting its original astral aspirations, forgetting its longing for each and every star."<|>
"It shall persist here, unknowing, unconcerned, perpetually the way it is now."<|>

units.displayText: That is what I thought, at the very least.

spans.text: That is what I thought, at the very least.

units.displayText: The door is knocked on lightly, and a strange voice comes from outside.

spans.text: The door is knocked on lightly, and a strange voice comes from outside.

units.rawText: Hello, is Hubble here?
units.displayText: Hello, is Hubble here?

spans.text: Hello, is Hubble here?

units.rawText: Someone's looking for you. A friend?
units.displayText: Someone's looking for you. A friend?

spans.text: Someone's looking for you. A friend?

units.rawText: Ah! It's a friend I made because of this novel. Her name is Fresnel.
units.displayText: Ah! It's a friend I made because of this novel. Her name is Fresnel.

spans.text: Ah! It's a friend I made because of this novel. Her name is Fresnel.

units.rawText: I heard her voice long ago, but this is our first time meeting. Hehe, I'm excited.
units.displayText: I heard her voice long ago, but this is our first time meeting. Hehe, I'm excited.

spans.text: I heard her voice long ago, but this is our first time meeting. Hehe, I'm excited.

units.displayText: "I'm Fresnel."

spans.text: "I'm Fresnel."

spans.text: I can't put my finger on why, but this feels familiar... this is the first time our orbits have crossed.

units.rawText: "Who knows with these things?"
units.displayText: "Who knows with these things?"

spans.text: "Who knows with these things?"

units.rawText: "But when I read that novel of yours, I felt the same."
units.displayText: "But when I read that novel of yours, I felt the same."

spans.text: "But when I read that novel of yours, I felt the same."

units.rawText: Ah... those accessories on your body, they reflect truly beautiful light.
units.displayText: Ah... those accessories on your body, they reflect truly beautiful light.

units.rawText: "Just like planets, right?"
units.displayText: "Just like planets, right?"

spans.text: "Just like planets, right?"

units.displayText: The sound of conversation fades. There is no blowing wind in the silence of space, only the finale of a bygone memory.

spans.text: The sound of conversation fades. There is no blowing wind in the silence of space, only the finale of a bygone memory.

units.displayText: "You like it too... right?"

units.rawText: My head still hurts a bit, but I feel better than ever before. Thank you.

units.displayText: Hubble flashes a mysterious smile, unlike what we had ever seen before.

spans.text: Hubble flashes a mysterious smile, unlike what we had ever seen before.

units.rawText: A tapping sound comes from the control panel. I turn to find the miniature Entropic, hurriedly knocking away—the Analysis System's progress bar slowly ticks on. At the same time, a bizarre icon speeds towards us.
units.displayText: A tapping sound comes from the control panel. I turn to find the miniature Entropic, hurriedly knocking away—the Analysis System's progress bar slowly ticks on. At the same time, a bizarre icon speeds towards us.

spans.text: A tapping sound comes from the control panel. I turn to find the miniature Entropic, hurriedly knocking away—the Analysis System's progress bar slowly ticks on. At the same time, a bizarre icon speeds towards us.

units.rawText: That's it... that's it! The Entropic Core!
units.displayText: That's it... that's it! The Entropic Core!

spans.text: That's it... that's it! The Entropic Core!

units.rawText: That's what it is! We should've figured it out long ago!
units.displayText: That's what it is! We should've figured it out long ago!

spans.text: That's what it is! We should've figured it out long ago!

units.rawText: That planet is red. Dark red... or rather, rust-red.
units.displayText: That planet is red. Dark red... or rather, rust-red.

spans.text: That planet is red. Dark red... or rather, rust-red.

units.rawText: It once drifted through the range of the spaceship's instruments, as if this interminable journey was thoroughly relevant to it; it has also approached without warning, like an uninvited catastrophe.
units.displayText: It once drifted through the range of the spaceship's instruments, as if this interminable journey was thoroughly relevant to it; it has also approached without warning, like an uninvited catastrophe.

spans.text: It once drifted through the range of the spaceship's instruments, as if this interminable journey was thoroughly relevant to it; it has also approached without warning, like an uninvited catastrophe.

units.rawText: And now, backed by rolling thunder, between the ash and smoke, the planet's surface dissolves, revealing a gigantic eye.
units.displayText: And now, backed by rolling thunder, between the ash and smoke, the planet's surface dissolves, revealing a gigantic eye.

spans.text: And now, backed by rolling thunder, between the ash and smoke, the planet's surface dissolves, revealing a gigantic eye.

units.rawText: Ghroth...
units.displayText: Ghroth...

spans.text: Ghroth...

units.rawText: I have been reconstructed... I shall return.
units.displayText: I have been reconstructed... I shall return.

spans.text: I have been reconstructed... I shall return.

units.rawText: This comes from your choices... we've been expecting this moment with joy in our hearts.
units.displayText: This comes from your choices... we've been expecting this moment with joy in our hearts.

spans.text: This comes from your choices... we've been expecting this moment with joy in our hearts.

units.rawText: On the topic of stars and fantasies, countless works of literature have been created. But what lies before us, the very name Hubble whispered, <color=red>"Ghroth"</color>—
units.displayText: On the topic of stars and fantasies, countless works of literature have been created. But what lies before us, the very name Hubble whispered, "Ghroth"—

spans.text: On the topic of stars and fantasies, countless works of literature have been created. But what lies before us, the very name Hubble whispered,
"Ghroth"

units.rawText: Is a celestial body symbolizing awakening, the gaze of another, and calamity.
units.displayText: Is a celestial body symbolizing awakening, the gaze of another, and calamity.

spans.text: Is a celestial body symbolizing awakening, the gaze of another, and calamity.

units.rawText: As Hubble's data was restored, this planet came to be restored as well. It finally opens its eyes from its slumber, akin to the icon on the monitoring panel, becoming this Starsphere's true core.
units.displayText: As Hubble's data was restored, this planet came to be restored as well. It finally opens its eyes from its slumber, akin to the icon on the monitoring panel, becoming this Starsphere's true core.

spans.text: As Hubble's data was restored, this planet came to be restored as well. It finally opens its eyes from its slumber, akin to the icon on the monitoring panel, becoming this Starsphere's true core.

units.rawText: The entire realm begins to convulse and swivel as if freely stretching its body and exhaling as it wakes.
units.displayText: The entire realm begins to convulse and swivel as if freely stretching its body and exhaling as it wakes.

spans.text: The entire realm begins to convulse and swivel as if freely stretching its body and exhaling as it wakes.

units.rawText: This is... the Entropic Core's true form...
units.displayText: This is... the Entropic Core's true form...

spans.text: This is... the Entropic Core's true form...

units.rawText: It's always been circling around us so casually! We went all this time without...
units.displayText: It's always been circling around us so casually! We went all this time without...

spans.text: It's always been circling around us so casually! We went all this time without...

units.rawText: Damn it, I'll begin analysis immediately!
units.displayText: Damn it, I'll begin analysis immediately!

spans.text: Damn it, I'll begin analysis immediately!

units.rawText: Hehehe... what seems to be the problem?
units.displayText: Hehehe... what seems to be the problem?

spans.text: Hehehe... what seems to be the problem?

units.rawText: Hubble finally seems to wake from that endless drowsiness, gesturing like when we first encounter each other in this Starsphere. That dark red planet moors in front of us, its great eyeball turning towards the spaceship.
units.displayText: Hubble finally seems to wake from that endless drowsiness, gesturing like when we first encounter each other in this Starsphere. That dark red planet moors in front of us, its great eyeball turning towards the spaceship.

spans.text: Hubble finally seems to wake from that endless drowsiness, gesturing like when we first encounter each other in this Starsphere. That dark red planet moors in front of us, its great eyeball turning towards the spaceship.

units.rawText: The force of gravity spikes in that moment!
units.displayText: The force of gravity spikes in that moment!

spans.text: The force of gravity spikes in that moment!

units.rawText: The asteroid below Fresnel and the escape pod next to her and torn to shreds by the force, and her body is drawn towards that planet like everything else close to her.
units.displayText: The asteroid below Fresnel and the escape pod next to her and torn to shreds by the force, and her body is drawn towards that planet like everything else close to her.

spans.text: The asteroid below Fresnel and the escape pod next to her and torn to shreds by the force, and her body is drawn towards that planet like everything else close to her.

units.rawText: Fresnel, tether!
units.displayText: Fresnel, tether!

spans.text: Fresnel, tether!

units.rawText: In a crucial moment, I immediately restart the thrusters. The spaceship sets off once more, and with the protection of the tether, I drag Fresnel out of the planet's gravity field.
units.displayText: In a crucial moment, I immediately restart the thrusters. The spaceship sets off once more, and with the protection of the tether, I drag Fresnel out of the planet's gravity field.

spans.text: In a crucial moment, I immediately restart the thrusters. The spaceship sets off once more, and with the protection of the tether, I drag Fresnel out of the planet's gravity field.

units.rawText: ...You're not coming?
units.displayText: ...You're not coming?

spans.text: ...You're not coming?

units.rawText: Why not? And we were so good together... we wanted to assemble again, so ardently.
units.displayText: Why not? And we were so good together... we wanted to assemble again, so ardently.

spans.text: Why not? And we were so good together... we wanted to assemble again, so ardently.

units.rawText: Come, Professor, Fresnel.
units.displayText: Come, Professor, Fresnel.

spans.text: Come, Professor, Fresnel.

units.rawText: Before the great red planet, Hubble gently levitates in space. She gently extends a hand towards the spaceship.
units.displayText: Before the great red planet, Hubble gently levitates in space. She gently extends a hand towards the spaceship.

spans.text: Before the great red planet, Hubble gently levitates in space. She gently extends a hand towards the spaceship.

units.rawText: Come to me.
units.displayText: Come to me.

spans.text: Come to me.

units.rawText: I understand everything. Let's Entropize together, and continue unto eternity...
units.displayText: I understand everything. Let's Entropize together, and continue unto eternity...

spans.text: I understand everything. Let's Entropize together, and continue unto eternity...

units.rawText: You've... hidden this from us?
units.displayText: You've... hidden this from us?

spans.text: You've... hidden this from us?

units.rawText: Seriously, Professor. When have I hidden anything? To you, of everyone.
units.displayText: Seriously, Professor. When have I hidden anything? To you, of everyone.

spans.text: Seriously, Professor. When have I hidden anything? To you, of everyone.

units.rawText: You helped me recover my data... you sheltered the Entropic Core, until it reached completion.
units.displayText: You helped me recover my data... you sheltered the Entropic Core, until it reached completion.

spans.text: You helped me recover my data... you sheltered the Entropic Core, until it reached completion.

units.rawText: Even if you knew nothing, you brought me to where I am, step by step.
units.displayText: Even if you knew nothing, you brought me to where I am, step by step.

spans.text: Even if you knew nothing, you brought me to where I am, step by step.

units.rawText: This starlight is so bewitching, so difficult to resist taking into one's arms.
units.displayText: This starlight is so bewitching, so difficult to resist taking into one's arms.

spans.text: This starlight is so bewitching, so difficult to resist taking into one's arms.
